name: zcu104
description: Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC ZCU104 evaluation board
comment_ps_preset_config: apply_bd_automation -config arg for the PS preset rule. ZynqMP needs only the board preset; Zynq-7000 boards (processing_system7) would use e.g. {make_external "FIXED_IO, DDR" apply_board_preset 1 Master Disable Slave Disable}.
comment_ps_config: Deltas applied on top of the board preset. The board preset (apply_bd_automation, requires the ZCU104 board files shipped with Vivado) configures DDR, UART, SD, USB, GEM etc. as wired on the physical board; we only enable the PL clock and the two AXI ports the VTA datapath needs (M_AXI_HPM0_FPD master + S_AXI_HPC0_FPD coherent slave). This replaces the ~270-line CONFIG.PSU__* dump in the legacy script.
comment_ports: Stable interface/port names wired by the generic recipe. Topology: VTA DRAM master -> SmartConnect -> PS coherent slave (HPC0); PS control master (HPM0) -> SmartConnect -> VTA control slave. One PL clock + one synchronized reset fan out to all three cells.
comment_addresses: Faithful to the legacy working design. {ps_cell}/{vta_cell} substituted by the recipe. The ctrl self-map (gmem -> ctrl/reg0) and the OCM/QSPI windows are carried over for parity with the known-good bitstream; the two essential segments are PS Data -> VTA ctrl, and VTA gmem -> DDR_LOW.
